packet.documentation: Free movement (osIROSE): the client moves its own character and tells the zone where it is and how it moves: at once when it starts or stops moving or changes walk / run, while moving on a turn of more than 10 degrees and at least every 200 ms, at most 10 a second. The zone checks it (speed x time, walk data) and relays it, or answers with PAKWC_MOVE_CORRECTION. Positions in cm; angles 0..65535 for 0..360 degrees, world space.

element.name: seq
element.documentation: Counts the client's states (wraps); after a correction the zone ignores states older than the one it corrected.

element.name: z
element.documentation: The client's height (the zone keeps none; relayed as given).

element.name: flags
element.documentation: Bit 0: moving (0: stopped at x, y). Bit 1: walking (else running).
